svg.title: STP: an RST BPDU in an 802.3 frame
svg.desc: Frame 2173 of The-Ultimate-PCAP.pcapng, 32 bits per row: the bridge group address 01:80:c2:00:00:00, the source 00:0a:8a:a1:5a:9a, an 802.3 length field of 39 instead of an EtherType, the LLC header 42 42 03, then the BPDU: protocol identifier 0, version 2 (Rapid), type 0x02, flags 0x3c, root identifier 32768/1/00:0a:8a:a1:5a:80, path cost 0, the same bridge identifier, port 0x8042, and the four timers; BpduPacket exposes the identifiers, the version, the type and the typed body.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
